tasks.title: Set up Python environment
tasks.description: Install Python and configure your code editor or IDE for Python development.

tasks.title: Learn basic syntax and variables
tasks.description: Understand Python's syntax rules, data types, and how to store information in variables.

tasks.title: Master control flow
tasks.description: Learn if/else statements, loops, and how to control the execution of your code.

tasks.title: Practice functions and modules
tasks.description: Learn how to create reusable code blocks and import external libraries.

tasks.title: Work with data structures
tasks.description: Understand lists, dictionaries, tuples, and sets for organizing data.

tasks.title: Build a simple project
tasks.description: Create a basic application like a calculator, to-do list, or number guessing game to apply what you've learned.

tasks.title: Explore object-oriented programming
tasks.description: Learn about classes, objects, inheritance, and encapsulation to structure your code effectively.

tasks.title: Continue learning and practicing
tasks.description: Build more complex projects, explore advanced topics, and contribute to open source or personal repositories.

tasks.title: Define current fitness baseline and set specific strength goals
tasks.description: Measure current lifting capacity or bodyweight exercises and establish clear, measurable targets for the 2-week period.

tasks.title: Create a structured 2-week strength training program
tasks.description: Design a workout schedule targeting major muscle groups with progressive overload, allowing for adequate rest between sessions.

tasks.title: Purchase or organize necessary workout equipment and attire
tasks.description: Ensure you have appropriate footwear, comfortable clothing, and any required weights or resistance bands for the planned routines.

tasks.title: Complete first week of training sessions as programmed
tasks.description: Follow the established workout schedule, focusing on proper form and tracking weights/reps performed each session.

tasks.title: Complete second week of training sessions as programmed
tasks.description: Follow the established workout schedule, aiming to increase weights or reps from the first week where possible, and monitor physical recovery.

tasks.title: Measure and record progress toward strength goals
tasks.description: Compare current performance to the baseline established on day 1 to quantify improvements in strength over the 2-week period.

tasks.title: Plan next phase of training based on achieved results
tasks.description: Review progress data and set new goals or adjust the training program for continued strength development beyond the initial 2 weeks.

tasks.title: Research local martial arts schools
tasks.description: Find schools offering styles suitable for beginners within commuting distance.

tasks.title: Attend trial classes
tasks.description: Visit 2-3 schools to observe teaching style and atmosphere before committing.

tasks.title: Purchase basic gear
tasks.description: Buy essential equipment like uniform, gloves, or protective gear depending on chosen style.

tasks.title: Establish training schedule
tasks.description: Block out consistent time slots in your calendar for regular practice sessions.

tasks.title: Learn fundamental stances and movements
tasks.description: Master basic postures, footwork, and introductory techniques from your chosen style.

tasks.title: Practice daily at home
tasks.description: Dedicate 15-30 minutes daily to reinforce techniques learned in class.

tasks.title: Set specific short-term goals
tasks.description: Define measurable milestones like learning a form, achieving a certain belt level, or mastering specific techniques.

tasks.title: Learn the basics
tasks.description: Complete the first basic lesson

tasks.title: Define goal scope and requirements
tasks.description: Clarify what needs to be achieved and identify key success criteria.

tasks.title: Gather necessary resources and information
tasks.description: Collect all materials, data, or tools required for the goal.

tasks.title: Create initial plan or outline
tasks.description: Structure the approach with milestones and action steps.

tasks.title: Execute first phase of the plan
tasks.description: Begin implementation with the first set of actions.

tasks.title: Review progress and adjust approach
tasks.description: Evaluate what's working and make necessary modifications.
